title: Composite and mixed sizers forward confirmation: fold f14 frozen, evaluated on 2026-09-07..2026-10-12
why: Late halves were not blind for either sizer. These 35 days are after data_end 2026-09-07: no weight, width cut, threshold, composite member choice, normalisation or knot has seen them. cs_aro's result on this window (INCONSISTENT, -0.12 vs width +0.30) was read before this file; cs_cmp / cs_mix forward results were not computed.

arms.cs_cmp: plan_fwd_cs_cmp.json -- NNNC_CS_CMP_f15: f14 weights (entries only), f14 width cut, cs_cmp f14 threshold 0.5851, composite on f14's normalisation (mean/sd of tradeable bars before f14's validation tail)
arms.cs_mix: plan_fwd_cs_mix.json -- NNNC_CS_MIX_f15: as cs_cmp plus f14's percentile knots (MIX_f14.json copied as MIX_f15.json), cs_mix f14 threshold 0.4867

composite_columns: the 7 member columns computed by the 037 harvest's own code (harvest_frame on the member classes + extras ratio_frame / raw8_frame) on candles through 2026-10-12; instrument: equal to the 037 cache on every overlapping bar before 2026-09-07 (NaN-equal), else the forward run is INCONCLUSIVE
identity: each arm's trades must equal fwd_w_aro's on (pair, open_date, close_date) (the sizer changes stakes only); else INCONCLUSIVE
primary: per arm: arm minus w_aro total pp on the forward window

read.power: ~49 trades (cs_aro's window); a blind sign check, not a test. Paired per-trade difference with a bootstrap 90% interval reported as context
read.secondary: arm minus cs_aro on the same trades; agree share on the forward trades (expected ~0.5)

no_adoption: nothing is adopted or promoted from this; promotion is the user's decision
